name: Text input
summary: Use a text input when a user needs to enter a short amount of text that cannot be selected from predetermined options.
whenToUse: Use for a short free-text answer such as a name, reference, or account identifier.
Choose a width that communicates the expected answer length when the expected format is known.
Add hint text only when it helps users provide the requested information.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for long answers; use the textarea component.
Do not use free text when users should select from a small, known set of options.
Do not set a maximum length merely to force visual width; input width and data validation are separate concerns.

anatomy.name: Form group
anatomy.description: Groups the label, optional hint, optional error, and input. Error state adds govuk-form-group--error.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: A visible label is programmatically associated to the input using for and id.

anatomy.name: Hint
anatomy.description: Supplementary guidance is referenced from aria-describedby when present.

anatomy.name: Error message
anatomy.description: An error is visible, includes a visually hidden Error prefix, and is referenced from aria-describedby.

anatomy.name: Input
anatomy.description: The native input keeps a stable id and name and receives the govuk-input class.

variants.name: Default
variants.use: A short free-text answer whose expected length is not usefully constrained visually.

variants.name: Fixed width
variants.use: An answer with a predictable maximum presentation length, such as a National Insurance number.

variants.name: Error
variants.use: Redisplay an invalid answer with a specific error message and linked error summary.

behaviour: The text input itself requires no GOV.UK JavaScript.
On validation failure, retain the user's answer unless doing so would expose sensitive information.
Server-side validation remains authoritative even when client-side validation is also used.
accessibility: Every input must have a visible label associated using matching for and id values.
List hint IDs before error IDs in aria-describedby so supporting information is announced in a useful order.
Add govuk-input--error and govuk-form-group--error together; colour alone is not the error message.
Use an appropriate autocomplete token and input mode when the requested data has a defined purpose or keyboard layout.
content: Ask one clear question and use the label as the primary prompt.
Do not use placeholder text as a substitute for a label or persistent hint.
Error messages should explain what went wrong and how to correct it without blaming the user.
